_note: The reads the Tickets cards make of the tk_ tables, by name: GET /api/p/<id>/plugins/tickets/q/<name>. The tickets themselves come from /api/p/<id>/tickets (files, engine/tickets.js). Read-only by construction; edit here, no restart.

deploys.sql: SELECT sha, short, subject, author, at, merge, tickets, pr FROM tk_deploy ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 300

envs.sql: SELECT env, at, version, ok, note FROM tk_env WHERE at = (SELECT MAX(at) FROM tk_env AS e2 WHERE e2.env = tk_env.env) ORDER BY env

env-history.sql: SELECT env, at, version, ok FROM tk_env WHERE env = ? ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 50

releases.sql: SELECT env, at, sha, prev FROM tk_release ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 100
releases._note: when each environment actually started serving a different commit - the real deploys
